text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. When I plan a trip, I always search for interesting places to visit and learn about local traditions. Visiting new cultures opens my mind and helps me understand how other people live. Trying different food is one of my favourite parts of travelling, because every dish tells a story about the country. Sometimes I face language barriers, but I use simple words or gestures to communicate. These moments can be funny and teach me to be patient. In the end, every journey creates unforgettable memories that I keep forever.
